messages:
Maria: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem — I'm consolidating action items for streaming partial responses & timeouts. Need owners & concrete dates. cc @Sam @Zhang
Sam: Can you paste the list? I'll take infra instrumentation work if needed.
Maria: Summarized — (1) server-side trace for partial chunks (owner: Sam) (2) client SDK reconnect behavior audit (owner: Alyssa) (3) retry-window & jitter docs + tests (owner: Zhang) (4) canary with smaller batch size + p95 timeout heatmap (owner: Jeff) (5) runbook update + oncall play (owner: Connor). Propose deadlines: 2w for infra traces, 1w for SDK audit, 1w for retry docs, 3w for canary, 1w for runbook.
Alyssa: I'll own client SDK audit. I'll instrument SDK logs + add test harness. ETA: 7 business days. Will also add example backoff config.
Zhang: I'll do retry-window docs & tests. Quick question: do we standardize on 'exponential with jitter' default? I can propose a policy.
Jeff: Canary plan: small pool = 4 GPUs, initial 5% traffic. I'll run p95 heatmap + token-level trace. Need Sam's traces to correlate.
Sam: Got it. I'll add a streaming chunk marker in the trace and expose a `chunk_size` tag. Will try to get the traces in 10 business days (need log ingestion fixed).
Connor: I'll update runbook and add immediate mitigation to disable streaming chunk coalescing on first-hit. Also add steps to escalate network flakiness to infra. ETA: 5 days.
Maria: Thanks. Two cross-cutting asks: (A) detect recurring partial responses pattern — can we add a detector query? (B) add synthetic traffic to exercise reconnects overnight. Owners?
Zhang: Detector query -> I'll write a saved log query for partial-chunk gaps and pipe alerts to #incidents. ETA 4d.
Jeff: Synthetic traffic -> I can spin up a small canary job for overnight (1 r/s across variants). I'll schedule it for next Monday.
deploy-bot: canary pool reserved for Jeff starting 2026-04-05. /ci
Alyssa: Snippet I'll add to SDK tests:
```python
# simulate mid-stream disconnect + reconnect
client.stream_request(prompt, on_chunk=cb)
simulate_network_glitch(drop_after=2)
assert cb.called_with_more_than(2)
```
Sam: Heads-up: backend change to connection keepalive is in flight (PR #5423). If merged, latency profile may shift. I'll coordinate.
Maria: Ok. I'll create a Trello board and add cards with owners/dates. Can everyone drop blockers here by EOD? Also Connor, add runbook link when done.
Connor: Noted. blocker: need access to runbook repo — @people-ops can you grant?
people-ops: people-ops: granted Connor edit to /runbooks/streaming.
Jeff: I'll post canary results + heatmap in 2 weeks.
Maria: :thumbsup: I'll follow up in 48h with the Trello and a weekly 30m sync invite. Thanks all.
